using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;

    if (n == 0) {
        cout << 0;
        return 0;
    }

    priority_queue<int> pq;
    int keep = n / 2 + 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        pq.push(x);
        if ((int)pq.size() > keep) pq.pop();
    }

    cout << pq.top();
    return 0;
}
